<a id="contracts-claimregistry"></a>
<p align="center"><img src="../docs/assets/md/contracts-01.svg" alt="contracts · ClaimRegistry: The on-chain part of Netra. Each published check is anchored here so anyone can confirm later that the grade they see is the one that was published, and that no registry serial range backs two claims. The contract does not mint, bridge or burn credits. Credits stay in their registry (Verra, Gold Standard). It only records a fingerprint of each check and of the serial ranges behind it. Minting tokens from retired credits can itself create double counting, which is why Verra banned it in 2022." width="100%"></p>

npm run demo:sepolia             # Ethereum Sepolia (PRIVATE_KEY in ../.env, a little test ETH)
npm run demo:base-sepolia        # alternative public testnet

<a id="trust-model"></a>
<p align="center"><img src="../docs/assets/md/contracts-05.svg" alt="Trust model: Question Answer Who can publish? Only an address with ATTESTER_ROLE (onlyRole on record and recordRoot). The deployer holds it, plus DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, which can grant it to others. The attester is stored with each check. Who can flag a double claim? Anyone, with no role. challenge checks both Merkle proofs itself, so a wrong challenge fails." width="100%"></p>
